description: CHARTER: what's running the meter — LLM spend, energy, and cost per post over time. Answers 'is the pipeline still cheap?'. Cost tracking, model performance, and LLM analytics PARKED 2026-07-02 (git history): cloud-$ per-model/provider/phase panels — structurally $0 while every LLM call is local (#1852); restore when cloud spend exists. Bench panels return when bench_run_results gets writes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT code, COUNT(*) AS clicks FROM affiliate_link_clicks_human WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY code ORDER BY clicks DESC

panels.title: Clicks by link
panels.description: Human clicks per affiliate code. Reads affiliate_link_clicks_human so per-link totals are not inflated by crawlers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(referrer, '^https?://[^/]+', ''), ''), '(direct)') AS source_page, COUNT(*) AS clicks FROM affiliate_link_clicks_human WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Clicks by source page
panels.description: Which page sent each human /go click, by referrer path. Replaces 'Clicks by post', which grouped by post_slug and could never populate: post_slug is derived from a /posts/<slug> referrer, and no published post carries an affiliate link yet (poindexter#930). Real traffic comes from /referrals and the homepage. Once in-post links land, their slugs appear here as /posts/<slug> rows.
Published-post count per content-type label (post_content_types, populated by ClassifyContentTypesJob). Multi-label — a post can hold several types, so counts sum to more than the number of posts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT content_type AS "Content type", COUNT(*)::int AS "Posts" FROM post_content_types GROUP BY content_type ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

panels.title: Posts by content-type

panels.description: Distinct posts carrying at least one content-type label.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT post_id)::int AS "Labeled posts" FROM post_content_types;

panels.title: Labeled posts

panels.description: Published posts with no content-type row yet — the classifier's remaining backlog. ClassifyContentTypesJob drains this every 6h; a persistent non-zero value means the job is disabled or erroring.

panels.title: Output tok/s by model (effective — wall-clock)
panels.description: Effective generation speed: SUM(output_tokens)/SUM(duration_ms) per bucket, per model. Wall-clock call time, so prompt processing and in-call queueing count — short-output QA verdict calls read slower than raw decode speed. This is the throughput the pipeline experiences; the Decode panel beside it is the model's raw speed. ollama/- and ollama_chat/-prefixed and bare spellings of the same model are merged. Console mirror: History → Model throughput (tok/s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time, regexp_replace(model, '^ollama(_chat)?/', '') AS metric, SUM(output_tokens)::float / NULLIF(SUM(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 0) AS value FROM cost_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_type = 'inference' AND output_tokens > 0 AND duration_ms > 0 AND success GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Decode tok/s by model (Ollama-reported)
panels.description: TRUE decode speed from Ollama's eval_duration split (cost_logs.decode_duration_ms, recovered through LiteLLM by services/llm_providers/ollama_timings.py). Numerator and denominator are FILTER-paired to rows that report a split — cloud models (anthropic/gemini/openai) and pre-2026-08-26 rows report none, so they draw no line here rather than a fabricated one. Compare with the effective panel: the gap is prompt processing + queueing. Console mirror: History → Decode speed (tok/s).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(created_at, $__interval) AS time, regexp_replace(model, '^ollama(_chat)?/', '') AS metric, SUM(output_tokens) FILTER (WHERE decode_duration_ms > 0)::float / NULLIF(SUM(decode_duration_ms) / 1000.0, 0) AS value FROM cost_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_type = 'inference' AND output_tokens > 0 AND duration_ms > 0 AND success GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Output tokens by model (hourly)
panels.description: Generation volume: output tokens produced per hour, per model — how much LLM work the pipeline is actually doing, and which model is doing it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, regexp_replace(model, '^ollama(_chat)?/', '') AS metric, SUM(output_tokens) AS value FROM cost_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_type = 'inference' AND output_tokens > 0 AND duration_ms > 0 AND success GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Model throughput detail (window)
panels.description: Uncapped per-model breakdown: call count, output-token volume, avg + p95 wall-clock call seconds, effective tok/s, and true decode tok/s (null when the provider reports no split). The console History cards cap to the top-N models (app_settings.llm_throughput_trend_max_models); this table is the full list.

targets.rawSql: SELECT regexp_replace(model, '^ollama(_chat)?/', '') AS "Model", COUNT(*) AS "Calls", SUM(output_tokens) AS "Out tok", ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS "Avg s", ROUND((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "p95 s", ROUND(SUM(output_tokens)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 0), 1) AS "Eff tok/s", ROUND(SUM(output_tokens) FILTER (WHERE decode_duration_ms > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(decode_duration_ms) / 1000.0, 0), 1) AS "Decode tok/s" FROM cost_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_type = 'inference' AND output_tokens > 0 AND duration_ms > 0 AND success GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Eff tok/s (window)
panels.description: All-model effective output tokens/sec across the dashboard window (total output tokens / total wall-clock call seconds).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(output_tokens)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 0), 1) AS "tok/s" FROM cost_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_type = 'inference' AND output_tokens > 0 AND duration_ms > 0 AND success

panels.title: Decode tok/s (window)
panels.description: All-model TRUE decode tokens/sec across the window, from rows that report Ollama's eval_duration split. Blank until post-2026-08-26 local calls accumulate; cloud calls never report one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(output_tokens) FILTER (WHERE decode_duration_ms > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(decode_duration_ms) / 1000.0, 0), 1) AS "tok/s" FROM cost_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_type = 'inference' AND output_tokens > 0 AND duration_ms > 0 AND success

panels.title: Output tokens (window)
panels.description: Total output tokens generated in the dashboard window (successful LLM inference calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS "tokens" FROM cost_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_type = 'inference' AND output_tokens > 0 AND duration_ms > 0 AND success

panels.title: LLM calls (window)
panels.description: Successful LLM inference calls in the dashboard window (token-bearing cost_logs rows; media/publish rows excluded).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "calls" FROM cost_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND cost_type = 'inference' AND output_tokens > 0 AND duration_ms > 0 AND success
